name: FluentTranslate
description: Built a Streamlit-based translation platform enabling document translation, speech synthesis, and multilingual content conversion for PDF and DOCX files.

paragraphs: FluentTranslate is a powerful, Streamlit-based web application designed to break down language barriers. Whether you are dealing with PDF/DOCX documents or raw text, this tool provides seamless translation, text-to-speech (TTS) synthesis, and document conversion—all in one intuitive interface.
features: Multi-Format Support: Upload and process DOCX or PDF files, or simply paste your text directly.
Google-Powered Translation: Leverages Google Translate for accurate, high-quality multilingual translations.
Text-to-Speech (TTS): Convert translated content into high-fidelity audio files (MP3) instantly.
Format Conversion: Automatically transform your translated text into downloadable Word documents.
Smart Analytics: Real-time word count monitoring and large-text handling warnings.
